gen-gf-oxanium-gf-parkinsans: Oxanium's uninterrupted monoline strokes and big-looking lowercase give the heading a commanding, distinctive look, while Parkinsans keeps its own strokes uniform below. Their shared single-stroke construction is what holds the pair together.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-preahvihear: Oxanium sets a commanding, monoline tone up top with curves that end in clear daylight. But Preahvihear's generous letter mouths and lofty x-height make paragraph after paragraph go down easily.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-prompt: Commanding on top, generous below. Oxanium does its best work in big, single-weight display lines, whereas Prompt's oversized small letters and open apertures are built for easy reading.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-pt-sans-caption: Inviting, unclosed bowls and big-bodied lowercase make this sans body read friendly and easy. PT Sans Caption handles the paragraphs while Oxanium's monoline heading strokes supply the commanding edge above.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-puritan: Commanding on top, soft and rounded below. Oxanium does its best work in big, single-weight display lines, whereas Puritan's rounded forms and generous counters are made for steady reading.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-questrial: Questrial has a flat, stencil-cut feel, with open curves and a tall band of letters beneath short stalks. And Oxanium shares that single-weight discipline, then adds a commanding, distinctive voice up top.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-radio-canada: Tall and full-bodied, Radio Canada's sans-serif letters finish every curve with a clear opening, no pressure variation anywhere. Oxanium's monoline headings echo that unbroken line, only louder and more commanding.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-radio-canada-big: Radio Canada Big reads full and open, with its x-height filling the line. Oxanium's commanding display heading shares the body's monoline skeleton, so the two sit together on a page like one voice at two volumes.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-readex-pro: Readex Pro keeps a steady weight from word to word, with broad terminal gaps built for reading. But Oxanium is the one to hand the big, commanding lines to, where its monoline curves can show off.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-roboto: Roboto keeps text smooth, with generous mouths on its round letters and little jump from capitals to lowercase. And Oxanium earns its keep when it is big and short, a commanding line or two.
